verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships its own background automations. Patterns runs the Loop agent on the trace backlog on a recurring schedule, online scoring evaluates production traces automatically and asynchronously as they are logged, and Topics continuously classifies traces. These are fixed-purpose features rather than a general, user-defined automation builder; CI/CD eval runs depend on the host CI platform, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a general-purpose user-configurable automation/trigger system, documentation of schedule configuration (frequency, triggers, actions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Patterns puts Loop to work on your trace backlog on a schedule.
Online scoring evaluates production traces automatically as they’re logged, running asynchronously with no impact on latency.
Topics continuously clusters every trace against them.
Topics automatically analyze and classify your logs without manual review.
